Model code only (`pipeline/dbt/models/marts/sales_summary.sql`) — updated the aggregate to reference the real source column:
- `sum(quantity) as total_quantity` → `sum(qty) as total_qty`

No Snowflake schema was altered; the fix aligns the model with the existing source schema.
